The '''D'olop Mountain Range'''<ref name="Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a mountain range on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] which housed a secret [[dragite crystal]] mine in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ROC2" />
